limitations: Two declared ordinary cases are coverage evidence, not a balance comparison.
An observation cap is not a victory; only a natural terminal has a winner.
Thirty-second samples can miss short wounds, queue jobs, eligibility windows and deaths.
missingMilitaryHp includes garrisoned/aboard land soldiers; AI medical Deficit excludes them. Its >=100 value does not prove medical eligibility.
Sample units omit garrisonedIn, complete state, attack preparation and full queued orders. Do not infer precise admission eligibility from samples alone.

Samples omit underAttack, age-saving and component protected reserves. A zero-purchase cause is unknown unless supported by full checkpoints/event evidence or a separately declared read-only diagnostic continuation.
A healthy-return event is accepted only with the exact declared 85% reason. Timeout, unavailable, death, manual override and safety releases are separate outcomes.
A full loop requires one patient episode: Retreat, positive HealingReceipt, exact 85% Return, then that patient's Fire before its next Retreat or Death.
Heal-only, doctor birth-only and timeout-return-fire routes are not full medical loops. Worker/scout healing is not automatically military recovery.
Money fields preserve recorded numeric values; no rounded wallet reconciliation or invented reserve balance is performed.
Step timings describe this headless observer, not native rendering FPS. maxStepMs is a maximum, not a percentile.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: manifest version/rulesHash/sourceFingerprint; two expected case identities; opening Age I/default opening; final event counts; natural_terminal versus observation_cap
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: A missing, incomplete or mismatched artifact is an evidence gap, not AI zero output.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.check: No order versus paid queue versus birth
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: doctor ProductionQueued, immediately preceding same-player/producer/time Payment transaction, UnitTrained target doctor ID, Spawn, Refund and producer/doctor Death
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: No queue: investment was not accepted. Paid queue but no birth: inspect queue progress, exit blockage, producer death or cancellation. Birth then death: not zero production.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: age>=2, workers>=12, non-explorer land soldiers>=6, actual eligible available soldier missing HP>=100, live+queued doctor count; second doctor requires soldiers>=20 and missing HP>=250
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: Thirty-second missingMilitaryHp is only a loose candidate. Recompute eligible available roles from a full checkpoint; brief unsampled windows stay unknown.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: same-decision !saveForAge and !underAttack, active/nonterminal/nonpaused player; AIStrategy/AgeAdvanced and full simulation agePlan provide partial evidence
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: Do not equate a large wallet with an open investment gate. Exact underAttack and decision-time gates are absent from samples.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: completed available mosque/church with empty queue, civilization/age eligibility, population used+reserved+1<=capacity, doctor cap, exact unit cost
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: Separate absent/unfinished/busy producer, population lock, unaffordable unit and production-exit delay. Opening/1500/final checkpoints are point evidence only.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: ordinary military/research payments occur before medical investment; protected age/political/worker/bank/special/civilization/siege/resource-continuity reserves; mosque critical worker-limit versus optional speed research
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: Wallet minus displayed unit cost is not the protected-spending test. Missing decision-time reserve values remain unknown; never infer a precise reserve cause from aggregate spent.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: doctor order/status/autoHeal/blockedUntil, actual positive receipt, available wounded patient, movement/combat lock/range/line; full checkpoint medical station and recovery cohort
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: Distinguish no wound, all patients fighting/moving/aboard, physician movement/busy orders, death and no safe reachable station. No sampled healingNow does not prove no healing between samples.

zeroOutputInspectionSequence.evidence: same-ID episode indexes/times, positive receipt HP delta, exact Return reason, first subsequent Fire before next Retreat/Death, timeout<=90s review allowance and retry cooldown state
zeroOutputInspectionSequence.zero_interpretation: Report successful loop, heal without return, successful return without fire, timeout/safety/manual/unavailable/death separately; no forced commands to manufacture coverage.
